prompts.own: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production TRANSPARENT RGBA animation atlas for Qiuqiu, the real silver-white LONGHAIRED cat in image 2. Lock one single cat identity across EVERY frame: same round face, large dark olive-black eyes, small dark grey triangular nose, same head size and natural body proportions. Subtle neck taper with a smooth fur transition, no pinched neck. Soft neutral studio illumination, no exposure/color changes, not cartoon, no exaggerated smile. Cat fully inside cell with 10px margins and paws baseline at cell y242; stable camera/scale/anchored body between frames. Row1: seated looking slightly left, front, slightly right, front (small rotations only). Row2: seated grooming raised paw: lick, lift toward cheek, wipe cheek, return paw slightly; keep same face and seated body. Row3: low lying chin on front paws, eyes resting; fluffy tail upright behind back, softly sweeps left/nearcenter/right/nearcenter. Row4: walking right, four small consecutive gait phases. Row5: running right, four consecutive restrained natural gallop phases, body scale fixed. Row6: seated enjoying petting: gentle closed-eye slow blink and tiny head tilt across four frames, no standing or waving, almost identical body silhouette to row1. The ENTIRE background between and around cats MUST have alpha zero, no grey/brown backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor/shadow, no text or grid. Fine alpha at outer hairs only. Reuse this exact cat for every frame, no breed/face/eye/size drift.
